_description: Single-room building layout (Room-101, 6m×5m×3m) with door spec. Tests that the building pipeline stamps all non-spatial elements and produces no fabricated source files.

assertions.name: coverage_100pct
assertions._comment: All non-spatial elements must carry Pset_BuiltingProvenance.

assertions.name: total_products_gte_10
assertions._comment: Regression gate — model must have at least 10 non-spatial elements.

assertions.name: walls_present
assertions._comment: At least 2 walls must be generated for the room enclosure.

assertions.name: no_fabricated_sources
assertions._comment: No element may reference a source file outside the allowed extension list.
